import sys

def main():
    line = sys.stdin.readline()
    if not line:
        return
    parts = line.split()
    if len(parts) < 3:
        return
    x, y, n = map(int, parts[:3])
    a = 0
    b = 1
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        p = x * i // y
        q = p + 1
        temp = i * abs(x * b - a * y)
        t1 = b * abs(x * i - y * p)
        t2 = b * abs(x * i - y * q)
        if t1 < temp:
            a = p
            b = i
            temp = t1
        if t2 < temp:
            a = q
            b = i
            temp = t2
    print(f"{a}/{b}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
